SQL_DOC.P_SQL: INSERT INTO EPRO_MRO.dbo.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_IF_S ( PROC_TYPE , CENTER_CD , ITM_NO , ITM_NM , SPEC , MAKER , ORIGIN , UOM , EST_REQ_DT , REQ_EMP_NO , REQ_EMP_NM , SUB_SUPP_NM , PRODUCT_ID , EST_PRICE , PRICE_DECI_DT , REG_DT , SEND_YN , SY_SEQ , REJECT_STAT , REJECT_DESC , RE_NO , RE_SEQ , SY_FG , COMP_CD , REQ_ID , CONT_ID , INPUT_EMP_NO , INPUT_DT , PUR_MINIMUM_QTY , ERP_RFX_NO , RFX_RECEIVE_REQ_DT ) SELECT PROC_TYPE , $PLANT$ AS CENTER_CD , $BUYER_ITEM_NO$ AS ITM_NO , $DESCRIPTION$ AS ITM_NM , $SPECIFICATION$ AS SPEC , $MAKER_NAME$ AS MAKER , $ORIGIN_NAME$ AS ORIGIN , $UNIT_MEASURE$ AS UOM , EST_REQ_DT , REQ_EMP_NO , REQ_EMP_NM , $SUB_SUPP_NM$ AS SUB_SUPP_NM , $ITEM_NO$ AS PRODUCT_ID , $UNIT_PRICE$ AS EST_PRICE , $ATOB_DATE$ AS PRICE_DECI_DT , GETDATE() AS REG_DT , 'N' , SY_SEQ , $REJECT_STAT$ AS REJECT_STAT , $REJECT_DESC$ AS REJECT_DESC , $QUOTATION_NO$ AS RE_NO , $QUOTATION_SEQ$ AS RE_SEQ , SY_FG , COMP_CD , REQ_ID , CONT_ID , INPUT_EMP_NO , INPUT_DT , $MIN_ORDER_QTY$ , ERP_RFX_NO , RFX_RECEIVE_REQ_DT FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_RFQ_IF_R WHERE SEQ = $SEQ$
